tip: Word exact waisa hi hona chahiye jaisa bold mein diya hai, modifications allowed nahi.

question: Direction: A word is provided along with four sentences (A, B, C, D). Determine which of the sentences use the word contextually and grammatically CORRECTLY. || Word: **EXHAUST** || A. The veteran marathon runner began to exhaust rapidly as he approached the final mile of the race. || B. The toxic exhaust from the old manufacturing plant is severely polluting the neighboring river ecosystem. || D. We must not exhaust our emergency financial funds on frivolous and unnecessary expenditures. || Question: Select the correct combination.
explanation: Sentence B mein 'exhaust' ka abstract meaning 'use up completely' (har rasta apna lena) hai. Sentence C mein 'exhaust' as a noun (dhuan/emissions) use hua hai. Sentence D mein bhi fund ko exhaust (khatam) karne ki baat hai. trick: Transitive verbs ko bina object ke use karna bohot common error hai. Insaan khud exhaust nahi hota, wo exhausted feel karta hai (passive sense).
tip: Transitive verbs ke baad hamesha ek object (noun/pronoun) aana chahiye.
